title: "What's your purpose now, Marine?"

description:
In this super-sized episode, we go behind the scenes of A Marvel Television Special Presentation: The Punisher: One Last Kill with Supervising Producer Eleena Khamedoost and Director Reinaldo Marcus Green! We also chat with writer Christos Gage and artist Edgar Salazar to discuss their new series, Civil War: Unmasked! Plus, we do some light wall-crawling with writer Dan Slott and artist Marcus To and learn about their new series Spectacular Spider-Man: Brand New Day. And we eat nuts and kick butts as we look at the comic book history of the unbeatable Squirrel-Girl! All time codes are approximate.

00:00 - Welcome back!

22:20 - Writer Christos Gage and artist Edgar Salazar on Civil War: Unmasked
32:00 - Writer Dan Slott and artist Marcus To on Spectacular Spider-Man: Brand New Day
42:12 - Comic book history of Squirrel-Girl!
